subject: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@gcp-marketplace.google.com>, partner-portal@google.com
Cc: Mark Liu <mark.liu@acmefin.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage

Hi Sara / Marketplace intake team,

Thanks for the intake call earlier — following up with the artifacts you requested to clear the listing tile and co-sell enablement. Two quick items we need to confirm so we don't hit re-review:

- Support coverage: Acme is asking for a clear statement on support hours (24/7 vs business-hours) and an escalation contact for co-sell deals. We have our standard 24x7 on-call for production incidents but want to confirm language that will appear on the listing.
- Claims: we will maintain the approved claim "99.9% availability for production inference" in the listing, but legal flagged that we should avoid absolute phrasing around "zero downtime".

Attaching the datasheet, SLA matrix, logo art, and SOC2 cert for intake. Can you confirm whether the GCP portal needs separate sizing or color variations for the tile asset? Also, is there any specific formatting required for the support/response-time table?

Attachments: [Attachment: gcp-listing-datasheet-v2.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: support_sla_matrix.xlsx (Excel)], [Attachment: redwood-logo-square.png (PNG)], [Attachment: SOC2-Type2-Cert.pdf (PDF)]

Next steps: if you confirm the required wording for the support block and any tile constraints we will produce a single asset pack (final PNG + SVG + alt text) and a short co-sell blurb for the Marketplace copy.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@gcp-marketplace.google.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, partner-portal@google.com
Cc: partner-ops@gcp-marketplace.google.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage

Hi Vivek — thanks for the package. Quick clarifications:

1) Support block: GCP requires a concise support statement and an escalation contact for co-sell. Suggested public wording: "Production support: 24/7 incident response; standard business-hours for feature requests. For co-sell escalations contact partner-ops@gcp-marketplace.google.com." Let us know if you need us to host the escalation contact or reference your support portal URL.

2) Claims: Please avoid any phrasing that implies SLA enforcement by GCP. The phrasing you suggested is fine if it reads as Redwood's commitment (e.g., "Redwood provides 99.9% availability for production inference"). Avoid comparisons (e.g., "best in class").

3) Tile assets: maximum PNG dimensions 1024x1024; provide an SVG for scaling. Color-safe background must satisfy WCAG AA contrast if text is overlaid.

If you can return the final tile and the single-line support blurb, we can queue the listing for a light compliance sweep. Expect the sweep to take 3 business days unless there are policy flags.

Regards,
Sara Patel
Marketplace Operations — GCP Partner Program

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sara.patel@gcp-marketplace.google.com, mark.liu@acmefin.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage

Laura / Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Sara's notes. Action items:

- Laura (Marketing): produce a 1-line support blurb that matches Sara's suggested public wording and craft the 30-word co-sell blurb (avoid superlatives). Also export final PNG at 1024x1024 and include SVG + alt text.
- Karthik (Legal): confirm the acceptable claim phrasing for the datasheet and the listing so we don't trigger a policy flag. Specifically, we want to keep "99.9% availability for production inference". Is that ok?
- Marissa (Revenue Ops / Marketplace): map the Co-sell SKU and prefill the marketplace intake form. If you need any HLD for the feature mapping, I can draft.

I copied Sara and Mark to keep external folks in the loop. Target to return final assets and language by EOD Thursday so Sara can kick off the sweep next week.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sara.patel@gcp-marketplace.google.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage

Vivek — quick legal read: the proposed language "Redwood provides 99.9% availability for production inference" is acceptable as long as we couple it with the standard exceptions and our published SLA link. Suggested footnote copy for the listing (short): "Availability measured per calendar month; exclusions apply (maintenance, force majeure). See full SLA at https://redwood.com/sla."

I also reviewed the datasheet and support matrix. Two redlines:
- Remove the phrase "unlimited burst capacity" from the public datasheet; it's a technical claim that requires quantification.
- In the support matrix, for co-sell deals we should indicate a 2-hour P1 response (on-call) and 8-hour P2 during business hours — we can keep 24x7 monitoring as a technical capability but avoid promising 'fix' times publicly.

Uploading a redlined copy to the Drive folder linked below. Once Marketing updates the two lines we should be good to go for the compliance sweep.

-Karthik

From: Mark Liu <mark.liu@acmefin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, sara.patel@gcp-marketplace.google.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage

Vivek / Sara — procurement note from Acme: we need an explicit escalation path and guaranteed contact (email + phone) for co-sell deals tied to our account. Can Redwood provide a named escalation engineer or is the escalation via the partner-ops mailbox only? Also need to confirm any committed response times for P1/P2 incidents in writing for our procurement file.

Thanks,
Mark Liu
Director, Procurement — Acme FinServ

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: sara.patel@gcp-marketplace.google.com, mark.liu@acmefin.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP listing: portal clearance sweeps + support coverage

Mark / Sara — final confirmation and next steps:

1) Support blurb we will publish: "Production support: 24/7 incident response; standard business-hours for feature requests. For co-sell escalations contact partner-ops@gcp-marketplace.google.com. Named escalation: Redwood on-call lead (escalations@redwood.com) with primary phone +1-555-0199 for account-level P1s."

2) Public claim: we will use Karthik's approved wording and a short SLA footnote linking to https://redwood.com/sla. Datasheet updated to remove "unlimited burst capacity".

3) Assets: Laura attached final PNG and SVG in the Drive folder and included the 30-word co-sell blurb. Marissa prefilled the intake form and mapped the co-sell SKU (ACME-REDWOOD-2027) — HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876543.

4) Compliance sweep: Sara — please confirm expected completion date after you queue the review. We will countersign any listing-specific language if required.

Attachments uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqZ-example-GCP-listing-artifacts
DocuSign (for Acme procurement signature) queued: https://www.docusign.com/link/ZYX-ACME-COSELL-2027

Thank you all — aiming to have the listing live in the portal the week after the sweep completes.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
